regions.merged_text: get worse but I kept on praying. I was afraid in fact to stop my prayers. "One day when things were at their worst and I could not feel I were receiving any additional necessary grace to manage under such conditions, the afternoon newspaper announced that a new Superintendent was appointed to the Hospital, 'a very fair and peaceful man .. 1 "He is indeed a peaceful man and very fair. Peace seemed to settle all over the place almost immediately upon his arrival. I had almost given up hope of any thing like that, and was just begging for grace to bear patiently with the many annoyances, etc. when on Thursday morning March 19th he came to our office and told us it was his birthday I fairly yelled with glee : "March 19th! What a wonderful birthday" The other girls asked me afterwards, "What in the world is there about March 19th?" ... never remembering that it is always the Feast of St. Joseph "Dont you think that was a generous answer from dear St. Joseph? And so attentive and personal. It just looked as if He had been figuring during the whole novena how to spring his delicate little surprise on me and this way increase my faith and confidence. 11
